text:
Sam: Uploading the customer's signed PO and the redline bundle from Legal. Attaching: acme-msaredlines.zip
Maria: Thanks — can you confirm whether the PO value matches the order form total? Need for billing mapping.
Sam: PO = $98,400, matches order form line items except the optional training add-on — that's not accepted in PO. @Maria please bill without training.
Anya: @Sam can you attach the MSA/DPA redline diff? I saw a handwritten change on clause 6.2 about subproc.
Sam: Sent the zip in the thread (acme-msaredlines.zip). Also included comment_summary.txt with the customer's asks.
Devon: From the customer's side — they want HSM key management and the EU data residency appendix. They also asked about a 99.9% SLA for inference.
Anya: We can accept HSM integration as an addendum. DPA needs a small tweak: vendor subprocessor list required within 30 days, not 14. Propose 30 days.
Maria: On signature routing: they want counterparty countersignature via DocuSign. Do we need our exec signature or Sales Ops suffices? @Anya
Anya: For this ARR exec approval threshold is $100k. We're under it but the DPA with HSM is a compliance risk — I'll need a 1-line exec approval. Recommend legal + security review signoff before countersign.
InfraBot: Reminder: security questionnaire (V1) pending — link: https://redwood.internal/secq/ACME-2389
Sam: Customer says they're ready to sign; they'd prefer not to hold up POC provisioning. Can we provision a dedicated sandbox before countersign with an NDA addendum only?
Anya: We can provision a timeboxed POC environment under an NDA and explicit risk acceptance. I need security to sign the risk acceptance.
Maria: I'll prepare the DocuSign envelope. Routing plan: Sales Ops -> Anya (Legal) -> CTO (exec) -> Customer signers -> Redwood countersign.
Devon: Customer signers: procurement@acme.com and engineering lead jane.perez@acme.com.
Sam: Also flagged pricing question: they'd like net30 instead of net45 — finance ok with net30 for this customer, @Maria to confirm.
Maria: Finance confirmed net30 conditional on PO reference and billing contact. I'll add fields to order form.
Anya: Quick note on redlines: MSA sec 9 indemnity cap — customer increased to 3x ARR. We need to cap at 1x ARR. I'll push back and document in the comment_summary.
Sam: Sending updated order form with fields populated and envelope draft: https://docusign.com/envelope/0a1b2c (draft)
InfraBot: Automated check: DPA includes subprocessor clause flag — requires vendor registry link. Please attach registry URL.
Sam: Attached registry link and updated addendum. @Anya please review, then I'll start the DocuSign send.
Anya: Reviewed. Two small edits in addendum (HSM responsibility line and data access logs). After you send, route to me for approve, then CTO for exec sign.
Maria: Sending envelope now. I'll add signer routing notes and set reminder cadence to 48h.
Devon: On our side we'll approve the NDA and start provisioning once we see the envelope sent. Thanks!
Sam: Thanks all — marking thread for follow-up. I'll post final signed copies when countersigned. :thumbsup:
